patterns.name: Measurement selection
patterns.description: Select a suitable measuring instrument or measurement method.

patterns.name: Physical-quantity estimation
patterns.description: Estimate a plausible value or order of magnitude for a stated physical quantity.

patterns.name: Definition
patterns.description: State or identify a precise physics definition.

patterns.name: Direct calculation
patterns.description: Apply one principal relationship or a short calculation route.

patterns.name: Multi-step calculation
patterns.description: Combine multiple relationships, conversions or intermediate results.

patterns.name: Uncertainty analysis
patterns.description: Determine, combine or report measurement uncertainty.

patterns.name: Graph construction
patterns.description: Plot or sketch a graph with required quantitative or qualitative features.

patterns.name: Force-diagram construction
patterns.description: Draw and label force arrows with their correct directions on an object.

patterns.name: Electric-field-line construction
patterns.description: Draw electric field lines with their correct direction, spacing and geometry for the stated field.

patterns.name: Vector-diagram construction
patterns.description: Draw and label vectors, including their directions and resultant, to represent a physical path or vector addition.

patterns.name: Motion-path representation
patterns.description: Draw a trajectory, travelled path or displacement line to represent motion between stated positions.

patterns.name: Graph interpretation
patterns.description: Extract values, relationships or physical meaning from a graph.

patterns.name: Explanation
patterns.description: Give a causal physics explanation for an observation, result or change.

patterns.name: Comparison
patterns.description: Compare two physical states, cases or outcomes using explicit criteria.

patterns.name: Interference analysis
patterns.description: Analyse superposition, path difference, phase difference or interference.

patterns.name: Circuit analysis
patterns.description: Determine or relate electrical quantities within a circuit.

patterns.name: Circuit-diagram construction
patterns.description: Draw a circuit using correct symbols and required series or parallel connections.

patterns.name: Equation completion
patterns.description: Complete a physical, nuclear or particle equation using conservation rules.

patterns.name: Equation derivation
patterns.description: Derive a standard physics relationship from definitions, principles or supplied relationships.

patterns.name: Equation recall
patterns.description: State a standard physics relationship and identify any symbols beyond those specified.

patterns.name: Classification
patterns.description: Identify or classify an entity using physics categories.

patterns.name: Property identification
patterns.description: State a characteristic, condition or physical value associated with a stated system.

patterns.name: Particle-model application
patterns.description: Apply particle or quark-model composition and transformation rules.
